description: Defines a utility class 'Random' for generating various types of random data, including strings, machine names, words, objects, sentences, paragraphs, and placeholder images within the Drupal project.

classes.name: Random
classes.description: A utility class for creating random data in Drupal.

methods.name: string
methods.description: Generates a random ASCII string of specified length with optional uniqueness and validation.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Generates a random string starting with a letter, containing upper/lower case letters and digits, with optional uniqueness.

methods.name: machineName
methods.description: Generates a lowercase alphanumeric string suitable for machine names, with optional uniqueness.

methods.name: word
methods.description: Creates a string that resembles a word with alternating consonants and vowels.

methods.name: object
methods.description: Creates a PHP object with a specified number of random string properties.

methods.name: sentences
methods.description: Generates placeholder Latin-like sentences with optional capitalization.

methods.name: paragraphs
methods.description: Creates multiple paragraphs of placeholder text.

methods.name: image
methods.description: Creates a placeholder image with random colored sections and a circle, saved to a specified destination.
